description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git ls-tree' command, verifying its behavior with different flags, pathspecs, and directory structures within a Git repository. It sets up test files, symlinks, and directories, then performs various 'git ls-tree' invocations and compares the output to expected results.

methods.name: test_output
methods.description: Defines a function to compare the current 'git ls-tree' output against an expected output, normalizing object IDs using sed and then comparing with test_cmp.
